title: Switzerland National Day
author: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
summary:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Switzerland National Day

Press Statement

August 1, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I extend my heartfelt congratulations to the Swiss people as you celebrate your National Day on August 1.

Our two nations share a longstanding partnership built on economic cooperation and a commitment to prosperity, innovation, and freedom. This spirit of collaboration is reflected in our strong trade relationship and our joint commitment to advancing innovation and technology.

Warmest regards on this special day. I look forward to the continuation of friendship between the United States and Switzerland in the years ahead.
